title: A WISDOM THAT DRAWS THE NATIONS

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the Lord my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it. Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people." - Deut 4:5-6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses tells the people that keeping God's decrees would display their "wisdom and understanding to the nations." When surrounding peoples saw Israel living by God's good laws, they would recognise something remarkable: "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people." Obedience to God was not just for Israel's benefit; it was to be a witness to the watching world, drawing others to notice the goodness of Israel's God.

This is a beautiful vision. God's people were meant to be a light, a living demonstration of what life under God's wisdom looks like. Their obedience would make God's character visible, provoking the nations to wonder and inquire. A life shaped by God's ways is inherently attractive; it stands out and points beyond itself to God.

This calling continues for God's people today. Jesus told His followers, "Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven" (Matt 5:16). The way we live — with integrity, love, justice, and grace — becomes a witness. When people see the difference God makes in us, they may be drawn to ask about the God we serve.

Our obedience, then, is never merely private. It has a missional dimension. As we live out God's wisdom, we display His goodness to a watching world. Peter urges believers to live such good lives that others, seeing our good deeds, may glorify God (1 Pet 2:12). May our lives, shaped by God's word and transformed by Christ, be a wisdom that draws others to the beauty of our God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Does your life display the wisdom and goodness of God to those around you?
2. How might your obedience become a witness that draws others to God?
3. In what area is God calling you to let your light shine more brightly?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let my life display Your wisdom and goodness to those around me. May my obedience be a light that points others to You, so that they too may glorify You, through Christ who shines in me. Amen.
